pitch: Talk to it once. It turns what you said into Ideas, cross-references your Ideas against everyone you know overnight, and drops a hand-drafted Move on the right person while you sleep.

icp.primary: Fractional CMO / CFO / CTO / COO / CHRO
icp.profile: 15+ years experience, ex-VP or C-suite, $150K to $1.5M annually across 2 to 7 concurrent retainers, whose relationships and sellable ideas live in their head. Mobile during the day, desktop on Sunday for planning.
secondary: Independent strategy advisors and boutique consultants
Thought-leader operators (author, keynote speaker, workshop facilitator)
icp.anti_icp: In-house SDR / outbound BDR sales teams (3+ seats). Circle is a single-operator product, not a Salesforce/HubSpot replacement for enterprise sales orgs.

magic_moment: Talk for about 90 seconds, get sellable Ideas, and wake to a hand-drafted Move on the right person.

current_offer.description: New accounts trial Operator features for 14 days, then revert to Freemium unless upgraded.
